aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Produces drafts only when required information is available and sourced claims have evidence.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Checks missing required fields, re-checks constraints during revision, and avoids finalizing when critical slots are missing.

aspects.name: ProvenanceFocused
aspects.text: Maintains provenance for externally sourced facts and requires evidence for sourced claims.

aspects.name: ConciseQuestioning
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions and limits questions per turn.

concepts.definition: Recurring internal communications sent within an organization to share updates and information.
Formal internal messages intended to broadcast important information.
Condensed summaries of recent updates collected into a single communication.
Short, high-level summaries prepared for executives.
Documents or outputs used in internal communications work, such as newsletters, briefs, or announcements.
The traceable origin and evidence trail for facts used in the draft.
Permitted methods or procedures for retrieving information from sources.
Accepted formats or containers used to store and return supporting evidence.
Marked as containing unresolved assumptions rather than fully verified information.
